name: omo-latest
purpose: Repository-owned latest skill assets for `bun tools/package-native.mjs --skill-source latest`. Staging reads ONLY this overlay, so the pinned checkout can never silently contribute latest assets.

AGENTS.md.note: Verbatim upstream pool-root developer doc; not a staged skill.

dependency.name: omowright
dependency.declaredIn: Root package.json devDependencies and bun.lock at oh-my-openagent v5.1.81; the locked npm tarball integrity matches the registry release, whose gitHead matches tag v0.3.1.

browserRuntime.note: The browser skill's engine runtime is build-materialized, never committed (see runtime/.gitignore), exactly as upstream gitignores skills/browser/runtime/omowright/. `--skill-source latest` requires --omowright-runtime <dir> and refuses a content-only browser tree; the staged manifest records this identity plus each runtime file's sha256. This is packaging of upstream skill content only: no desktop/browser implementation, engine authorization or extension bridge.

ultrawork.source: mhc MIT contract/core.md (todo 15); skill metadata based on lazycodex@75b01747, adapted for O06
mhc-authored (MIT): independent whole directive based on the local ultrawork contract (O06)

targetInventoryProvenance.note: The mc:H target rows below retain the historical migration inventory, not the current shipped file set. The skills map is the authoritative current file inventory and hash binding; selection is the current staged skill set. loader.resolution: crates/omo/maho-omo/src/component_list.rs: SKILLS_ROOT_ENV + builtin_skills_root() (a set non-empty env root wins, else <exe dir>/skills, else relative skills); consumed in crates/maho-cli/src/cli/omo_mount.rs:38-40 (env root -> OMO_SENPI_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills -> builtin_skills_root). The staged manifest records sources.latestAssets.loader = { skillsRoot: "skills", env: "OMO_SENPI_SKILLS_ROOT" }.
loader.invocation: bun tools/package-native.mjs --binary <mhc> --output <install> --skill-source latest --git-bash-binary <omo-git-bash> --omowright-runtime <materialized runtime dir>; the installed tree is then exercised through the native app-server: `mhc app-server --listen stdio://` with MAHO_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<install> and JSON-RPC `skills/list` (crates/maho-server/src/app_server/skills.rs). The OMO packaged root itself (OMO_SENPI_SKILLS_ROOT -> builtin_skills_root()) is consumed by the onboarding, init-deep-advisor and skill-pointers components and by the telemetry skill_loaded event (crates/omo/components/maho-omo-telemetry/src/omo_native_tools.rs::builtin_skill_name); it has no CLI/RPC list surface of its own.

contentBinding.mechanism: The skills map declares each selected skill's complete file set; staging refuses a set that differs (a missing or extra file is `latest overlay is incomplete`). Every staged file is hashed into the package manifest at stage time, and every declared sha256 is checked against the overlay bytes before staging.
